_comment_1: Build configuration for the LOCAL development backend (tools/local_backend/). Consumed via --dart-define-from-file, which is what makes the IDE's plain Run button work - without it the app starts with no backend values and shows the 'build is not configured' screen.
_comment_2: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY below is not a secret. It is a JWT carrying role=anon, signed with the development secret that is already in tools/local_backend/gateway.py, and it is only accepted by a gateway running on this machine's loopback interface. It grants nothing on its own - every request it makes is still filtered by Row Level Security.
_comment_3: NEVER add a real project's keys to this file. Real keys belong in CI secrets and are passed with --dart-define at build time; see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
_comment_4: Realtime and Storage are not emulated by the local gateway - it answers 501 on both. Leaving realtime on would retry a websocket that can never connect.
